title: This is BiCS NAND Close Up from Kioxia and Sandisk
gist: ServeTheHome shares FMS 2026 microscope photos of Kioxia and Sandisk BiCS NAND, including Kioxia's 332-layer BiCS Gen 10 1Tb TLC part using CBA technology. The author frames NAND demand as through the roof because of AI.

insights.claim: Kioxia showed a BiCS FLASH Generation 10 1Tb TLC NAND wafer that uses CBA technology and has 332 layers.
insights.speaker: Eric Smith
insights.so_what: Layer count and CBA bonding indicate the current NAND density frontier for Kioxia and its partner.
insights.quote: It uses CBA technology and has 332 layers.

insights.claim: BiCS NAND is a joint effort by Kioxia and SanDisk, and both showed it under microscopes at FMS 2026, with SanDisk displaying Generation 8.
insights.speaker: Eric Smith
insights.so_what: The two partners remain technology-aligned, so both share exposure to NAND cycle and AI storage demand.

insights.claim: NAND demand is through the roof because of AI, and fitting higher capacities and speeds into packages is a hard engineering challenge.
insights.speaker: Eric Smith
insights.so_what: AI-driven storage demand supports NAND suppliers' pricing and capex.
insights.quote: NAND is a hot topic today as the demand is through the roof with AI.
